name: flow
description: The whole development flow - define, plan, build, verify, review, ship - from an idea, one ticket or many tickets: /flow:go. Parallel AI agents in git worktrees, PRs reviewed on the PR until approved, the GitHub project board, one test run at the end. Engineering skills adapted from addyosmani/agent-skills (MIT), plus Meshy and Tripo 3D model generation and outfits painted onto one rigged body's UV map.
